description: Texas A&M University provides synthetic phasor measurement data generated using the ACTIVSg2000 electricity-network model for Texas. Each file covers one hour for a particular area of the model. The provider lists CSV and IEEE COMTRADE 2013 formats and discusses geographical and temporal variation, system controls and noise in generating the signals. These are simulated measurements, not observations of the real Texas grid. They support analysis of simulated network behaviour and are distinct from the underlying network topology. Sampling frequency and calendar dates are not stated. The provider says further scenarios and validation are in progress. Use is free under custom commercial and non-commercial terms, with citation encouraged. The download form requires email. Cached page metadata was reviewed; direct requests returned 403 and no data file was obtained. Related resources are linked through the parent catalogue. Download contents remain unverified.
